column1: # Bitwuzla's own settings, now that KLEE can reach them.
# Anchored on bwz-incr rather than bwz-default: the session is the fairer
# Bitwuzla, so a knob is asked about on top of it rather than on top of a
# handicap. One variable moves per row.
# The abstraction width is the row with a reason behind it. This corpus is
# floating point; an fp.mul on doubles blasts to a 53-bit multiply, and
# Bitwuzla abstracts at 33 by default, so every one of them is abstracted
# already. Turning the abstraction off measured worse (1.061), which says the
# line is on the right side of these terms -- bv17 and bv24 ask whether it
# wants to be further down still, taking narrower terms with it.
# rwl1 is the cheap half of the rewriter. There is no level above the default,
# so this row can only lose; it is here to say by how much rather than to win.
# The SAT backend is absent because it cannot be asked yet: this libbitwuzla
# has only CaDiCaL compiled in, and kissat needs it rebuilt with -Dkissat=true
# and KLEE relinked, which would move every other number on the same page.
# label <TAB> backend <TAB> LD_LIBRARY_PATH for libstp (or -) <TAB> extra klee args
bwz-incr
bwz-incr-bv17
bwz-incr-bv24
bwz-incr-rwl1
stp-thr0
